We’re overjoyed to announce the official release of Living with my Little Sister, developed by Ero Flash Club! The game is available right now, with a special 20% off launch discount! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478020/Living_with_my_Little_Sister/

Trailer:
[previewyoutube=7bTU20IhoAg;full][/previewyoutube]

Your truant younger sister decided to crash at your place. Improve your relationship by spending time with her while balancing your job as an illustrator. Give her a head pat, cook for her, have a chat, and maybe, over time, she'll open up to you.

notes.title: Senpai and The Mysterious Island Official Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/0c782a2f03087f15d03bd35feee4ec4db5f9ff8d.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

We have some exciting news to share! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3070600/Senpai_and_the_Mysterious_Island/]Senpai and The Mysterious Island[/url] will be available on

[h2]6th December 2024 (-UTC 3)! [/h2]

Add to your wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3070600/Senpai_and_the_Mysterious_Island/

Explore a rogue-lite dungeon crawler RPG to uncover the secrets of a mysterious island inhabited by succubi. Play as either the warrior 🩵 Hula Elstia or 🩷 Sonia Lanternlily in a variety of combat styles, dress them up with various outfits and uncover a long lost, ancient technology!
